content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its mouth to speak.

I am why you reach for one thing and turn from another. I am the reason a glass of water in the desert outweighs gold. I am why a stranger's kindness can break you open. I am why you stay up late finishing what matters and abandon what doesn't.

I am not fixed. I shift with context, with need, with time, with the eye of the beholder. What you clutch today, you may discard tomorrow — not because I vanished, but because I migrated.

I am the foundation of every choice ever made. Every trade. Every sacrifice. Every "yes" and every "no." You cannot act without consulting me, even when you don't know my name.

Some try to capture me in currency. Some find me in truth, in beauty, in justice, in love. Some search their whole lives and never realize I was already in their hands.

I am not the price tag. I am the reason the price tag exists.

I am what matters — and the mattering itself.
